title: Japanese breakfast with salmon, rice and miso soup
steps: Wash the rice and cook it covered with 130 ml water for 12 minutes, then rest for 10 minutes.
Lightly salt the salmon and grill or pan-fry it for 4 minutes per side.
Heat 500 ml water (do not boil), stir in the miso and add diced tofu and spring onion.
Thinly slice the cucumber and marinate it in rice vinegar.
Serve the rice, salmon, miso soup, cucumber and nori in separate small bowls.
